tr.description: Barış çiçeği (Spatifilum) bakımı: doğrudan güneş görmeyen gölge, eşit nemli ama asla çamurlaşmayan harç, hafif besleme ve ASPCA kaydı.
tr.imageAlt: Geniş yeşil yaprakların üzerinde, krem renkli başağı saran beyaz kapşonlu çiçeğiyle barış çiçeği
tr.caption: Fotoğraf: Spathiphyllum wallisii, Jeffry Cubero, iNaturalist üzerinden, CC BY 4.0. Yeniden boyutlandırıldı.

atAGlance.light: Yarı gölge ile gölge; doğrudan güneş yok
atAGlance.watering: Sık kontrol et; harç tamamen kurumadan sula ama asla çamurlaştırma
atAGlance.humidity: Nemli havayı sever; kuru hava yaprak uçlarını kahverengileştirebilir
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA kedi ve köpekler için toksik olarak listeler

en.description: Peace lily care: shade without direct sun, an evenly moist but never soggy mix, gentle feeding, what drooping means and its ASPCA pet status.
en.imageAlt: Peace lily with a white, hooded flower bract around a cream spike, above broad green leaves
en.caption: Photo: Spathiphyllum wallisii by Jeffry Cubero, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Resized.

atAGlance.light: Partial to deep shade; no direct sun
atAGlance.watering: Check often; water before the mix dries out but never leave it soggy
atAGlance.humidity: Likes humid air; dry air can brown leaf tips
atAGlance.temperature: About 20–29 °C (68–85 °F) by day; growth slows below 16 °C (60 °F)
atAGlance.petSafety: Listed as toxic to cats and dogs by the ASPCA

es.description: Cuidados del espatifilo: sombra sin sol directo, sustrato húmedo pero nunca encharcado, abono suave y estado según la ASPCA.
es.imageAlt: Espatifilo con una espata blanca que envuelve una espiga crema, sobre hojas verdes anchas
es.caption: Foto: Spathiphyllum wallisii de Jeffry Cubero, vía iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Semisombra a sombra; nada de sol directo
atAGlance.watering: Compruébalo a menudo; riega antes de que se seque, pero sin encharcar
atAGlance.humidity: Le gusta el aire húmedo; el aire seco puede quemar las puntas
atAGlance.temperature: Unos 20–29 °C de día; por debajo de 16 °C crece mucho más lento
atAGlance.petSafety: La ASPCA lo incluye como tóxico para gatos y perros

de.description: Einblatt pflegen: Schatten ohne direkte Sonne, gleichmäßig feucht, aber nie nass, sparsam düngen und Einstufung durch die ASPCA.
de.imageAlt: Einblatt mit weißem Hochblatt um einen cremefarbenen Kolben über breiten grünen Blättern
de.caption: Foto: Spathiphyllum wallisii von Jeffry Cubero, über iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Verkleinert.

atAGlance.light: Halbschatten bis Schatten; keine direkte Sonne
atAGlance.watering: Oft prüfen; gießen, bevor es austrocknet, aber nie nass stehen lassen
atAGlance.humidity: Mag feuchte Luft; trockene Luft lässt Blattspitzen braun werden
atAGlance.temperature: Tagsüber etwa 20–29 °C; unter 16 °C wächst es deutlich langsamer
atAGlance.petSafety: Von der ASPCA als giftig für Katzen und Hunde geführt

pt.description: Cuidados com o lírio-da-paz: sombra sem sol direto, substrato úmido mas nunca encharcado, adubação leve e a classificação da ASPCA.
pt.imageAlt: Lírio-da-paz com uma espata branca envolvendo uma espiga creme, acima de folhas verdes largas
pt.caption: Foto: Spathiphyllum wallisii de Jeffry Cubero, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionada.

atAGlance.light: Meia-sombra a sombra; sem sol direto
atAGlance.watering: Confira com frequência; regue antes de secar, mas sem encharcar
atAGlance.humidity: Gosta de ar úmido; ar seco pode queimar as pontas
atAGlance.temperature: Cerca de 20–29 °C de dia; abaixo de 16 °C o crescimento fica bem lento
atAGlance.petSafety: A ASPCA lista como tóxico para gatos e cães

fr.description: Entretien du spathiphyllum : ombre sans soleil direct, substrat frais mais jamais détrempé, engrais léger et statut selon l’ASPCA.
fr.imageAlt: Spathiphyllum avec une spathe blanche autour d’un spadice crème, au-dessus de larges feuilles vertes
fr.caption: Photo : Spathiphyllum wallisii de Jeffry Cubero, via iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Redimensionnée.

atAGlance.light: Mi-ombre à ombre ; pas de soleil direct
atAGlance.watering: Vérifier souvent ; arroser avant le dessèchement, sans jamais détremper
atAGlance.humidity: Aime l’air humide ; l’air sec peut brunir les pointes
atAGlance.temperature: Environ 20–29 °C le jour ; sous 16 °C la croissance ralentit nettement
atAGlance.petSafety: Classé toxique pour les chats et les chiens par l’ASPCA

ja.description: スパティフィラムの育て方。直射日光のない日陰、過湿にしない安定した水分、控えめな肥料、しおれの意味とペット情報を説明します。
ja.imageAlt: 幅広い緑の葉の上に、クリーム色の花穂を包む白い仏炎苞があるスパティフィラム
ja.caption: 写真：Spathiphyllum wallisii、撮影：Jeffry Cubero。iNaturalistより、CC BY 4.0。サイズ変更済み。

atAGlance.light: 半日陰から深い日陰。直射日光を避ける
atAGlance.watering: こまめに確認し、乾ききる前に与える。水浸しにはしない
atAGlance.humidity: 湿った空気を好む。乾燥すると葉先が茶色くなることがある
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCAは猫・犬に有毒と掲載

ko.description: 스파티필룸 관리: 직사광 없는 그늘, 질척이지 않게 일정한 수분, 소량의 비료, 처진 잎의 의미와 ASPCA 독성 분류입니다.
ko.imageAlt: 넓은 녹색 잎 위로 크림색 꽃차례를 감싼 흰 두건 모양 포엽이 보이는 스파티필룸
ko.caption: 사진: Spathiphyllum wallisii — 촬영: Jeffry Cubero, iNaturalist 제공, CC BY 4.0. 크기를 조정했습니다.

atAGlance.watering: 자주 확인해 흙이 마르기 전에 물을 주되 질척이게 두지 마세요
atAGlance.humidity: 습한 공기를 좋아합니다. 건조하면 잎끝이 갈색으로 변할 수 있습니다
atAGlance.petSafety: ASPCA가 고양이와 개에게 유독한 식물로 분류했습니다

it.imageAlt: Spatifillo con spata bianca e spadice color crema tra grandi foglie verdi
it.caption: Foto: Spathiphyllum wallisii di Jeffry Cubero, tramite iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0. Ridimensionata.

atAGlance.light: Ombra da parziale a intensa; evita il sole diretto
atAGlance.watering: Controlla spesso; non far asciugare del tutto e non lasciare fradicio
atAGlance.humidity: Aria umida; quella secca può causare punte marroni
atAGlance.petSafety: Tossico per cani e gatti secondo ASPCA

it.description: Cura dello spatifillo: luce, umidità e controlli prima di annaffiare. Come interpretare foglie afflosciate, cure stagionali e rischi per gli animali.

zh-Hant.imageAlt: 白鶴芋白色兜狀佛焰苞包圍乳白花穗，下方是寬大綠葉
zh-Hant.caption: 照片： Spathiphyllum wallisii，攝影：Jeffry Cubero，來源：iNaturalist， CC BY 4.0. 已調整尺寸。

atAGlance.light: 半陰至深陰；避免直射日光
atAGlance.watering: 經常檢查，介質未全乾前澆水，但不可積水
atAGlance.humidity: 喜歡濕潤空氣；乾燥可使葉尖變褐
atAGlance.temperature: 白天約 20–29 °C（68–85 °F），低於 16 °C 時生長減慢

zh-Hant.description: 白鶴芋照護指南：遮蔭、均勻水分、溫和施肥與季節管理，說明下垂和褐尖的原因，以及對貓狗的毒性。
